title: 第11章 华夏神龙

content_zh:
俩人的心也随之不停的晃动。
渐渐的泛起红色的光芒，将龙蛋表面上的血液慢慢吸收。
可是这种吸收好似不是在全部吸取，而更象是在那些血液里寻找着什么，挑选着吸取。
情景有些诡异，就算是俩人艺高胆壮，见到这副场景心里还是有些发毛。
蛋壳表面的血液的越来越来淡，慢慢的全部消逝不见。
巨蛋又是一阵晃动。
俩人有些莫名其妙了，都没血了，你还晃什么？
见到俩人没反映，巨蛋晃得更厉害了。
“它这是怎么了？”亚菲特疑惑的问到。
刘枫耸了耸肩，示意自己也不是很清楚。
正在俩人大眼瞪小眼，无奈的时候。
一个非常稚嫩的声音在刘枫心底想起：“血。。还要。。”
身体突的一震，刘枫咽了一口口水：“你有没有听到它在说话？”
亚菲特龙躯一抖：“你还真是会开玩笑，它一个蛋能说什么话？”
“难道我听错了？”刘枫自己也有些糊涂，但是这点糊涂马上便被冲到了天边去了。
“血。。要。。”又是一句稚嫩的声音，竟然已带上了点点哭腔。
“我靠，真的在说话，你难道没听见？”刘枫瞪大了眼睛，死死的盯着龙蛋。
“啊。。哈哈。。怎么可能，我看你是精神实在是太疲劳了，我帮你出去找点吃的。。”说完，猛的变回龙身，逃也似的飞了出去。
“妈的，还是一条巨龙呢，胆子这么小。”刘枫在下面对着那腾飞的巨大身躯比起了中指。
俩步走到巨蛋身边，轻轻的问道：“你是还想要血？”

巨蛋一阵轻微的晃动。
“哎。。好吧。。就当一次献血民工吧。。”思量了片刻之后，刘枫下定了决心，一定要把这枚蛋给孵出来。
狠狠咬了咬牙，右指弹出一截短短的剑罡，在手腕处轻轻一划，鲜血滚滚而出，淌上了巨蛋。
巨蛋又开始泛起了红色光芒，慢慢的吸取着那有些温暖的血液。
血液是人体之中最为重要的一部分，失去过多的话，危及生命。
鲜血滚滚而下。
终于在十分钟之后，刘枫摇摇欲坠的软到在巨蛋旁边。
“这么多血，你要是还不出来，我也没办法了。”刘枫疲惫的道。
巨蛋似乎是听懂了似的，轻轻靠了靠一旁的刘枫。
巨蛋慢慢开始有了反映，表面的颜色迅速了开始变红。
温度越来越高，一旁的刘枫都有些忍受不住，体内的真气来回的转了俩圈，这才是稍好了一些。
白色的雾气不知道什么时候，慢慢的出现了起来，将巨蛋围了起来。
一股威武，华贵，强悍的气息缓缓从白色的雾气中散发出来。
巨大的山洞之外，正在猎物的亚菲特忽然心中一跳，一股不可抗衡的气息冲了过来。
心中没有任何抵抗的，也根本抵抗不了的软到了地上，遥遥的朝着山洞的方向，低头膜拜。
“这是？。。龙神？天呐。。”
冲天的庞大气息，在天空之中卷起了无数白云，不住的翻滚跳跃。
尤为壮观。
大陆之上。
某四座学院之中，四位老头猛的睁开双瞳，不可置信的失声喊道：“至尊级？？？是谁？？？”

某个平凡的角落，俩位正在栽树种花的垂暮老人，手中的剪子一颤，互相抬头对视了一眼，看出了对方眼中的凝重，身影一动，人也消失不见，只有一旁被无意减落的树叶证明着此处有人存在过。
大陆某座庞大的城市，位于最顶端的一座华丽教堂，一位正在翻看圣经，头带圣冠的白袍老人，忽的身体一动，人已不见，只余一篇刚刚翻出的经文。
大陆历二十三年，人类国度再次出现至尊强者气息。
在人类国度之外，众多强者发出了深深的叹息。
“人类，果然是神眷之族。”
**************
山洞之中，刘枫有些震撼的盯着翻腾不休的白色烟雾。
刚刚那股气息，他也感觉到了，不过它似乎对自己没有什么敌意。
所以气息也只是轻轻的在自己身边滑过，不过，就算如此，刘枫也感觉到了那股气息的强悍。
强悍气息隐带四字：无以伦比。
半晌之后，气息慢慢休止，白烟也渐渐消逝。
忽的，一闪电的金光划过虚空，扑进了刘枫的怀中。
被这速度又是震撼了一把，自己用上疾风步也没有这般快速吧？
低头看着怀中的可爱生物，刘枫满心欢喜。
骆头，蛇脖，鹿角，龟眼，鱼鳞，虎掌，鹰爪，牛耳。

content_en:
The hearts of the two of them also kept shaking.
A red light gradually glowed, slowly absorbing the blood on the surface of the dragon egg.
But this kind of absorption does not seem to be absorbing everything, but more like searching for something in the blood and selectively absorbing it.
The scene was a little weird. Even though the two of them were very talented and brave, they still felt a little scared when they saw this scene.
The blood on the surface of the eggshell became lighter and thinner, and slowly disappeared.
The dome shook again.
The two of them are a little confused. They have no blood, so what are you talking about?
Seeing no reaction from the two of them, the dome shook even more violently.
"What's wrong with it?" Yafit asked doubtfully.
Liu Feng shrugged, indicating that he was not very clear either.
Just when the two of them were staring at each other helplessly.
A very childish voice came to Liu Feng's mind: "There's more blood..."
His body suddenly trembled, and Liu Feng swallowed a mouthful of saliva: "Did you hear it talking?"
Yafit's dragon body trembled: "You really know how to joke. What can it say with an egg?"
"Did I hear it wrong?" Liu Feng himself was a little confused, but this confusion was immediately washed away.
"Blood... I want..." was another childish voice, with a hint of crying.
"Damn, they are really talking. Didn't you hear me?" Liu Feng's eyes widened and he stared at the dragon egg.
"Ah... Haha... How is that possible? I think you are too mentally exhausted. Let me help you go out and find something to eat..." After saying that, he suddenly transformed into a dragon body and flew out as if he was running away.
"Damn, it's still a giant dragon, so timid." Liu Feng raised his middle finger from below to the huge soaring body.
He walked to the dome in two steps and asked softly: "Do you still want blood?"
The dome shook slightly.
"Hey... okay... let's just be a blood donation migrant worker..." After thinking for a moment, Liu Feng made up his mind to hatch the egg.
Gritting his teeth hard, he flicked out a short sword sword with his right finger and lightly swiped his wrist. Blood rolled out and dripped onto the dome.
The dome began to glow with red light again, slowly absorbing the somewhat warm blood.
Blood is the most important part of the human body. Losing too much of it can be life-threatening.
Blood rolled down.
Finally, ten minutes later, Liu Feng was so weak that he was beside the dome.
"With so much blood, if you still don't come out, there's nothing I can do." Liu Feng said tiredly.
Dome seemed to understand, and gently leaned against Liu Feng.
The dome slowly began to reflect, and the surface color quickly began to turn red.
The temperature was getting higher and higher, and Liu Feng on the side couldn't bear it. The Qi in his body turned back and forth twice, and now he felt a little better.
I don't know when the white mist slowly appeared and surrounded the dome.
A mighty, luxurious, and powerful aura slowly emanated from the white mist.
Outside the huge cave, Yafit, who was hunting, suddenly felt his heart skip a beat, and an unstoppable aura rushed over.
There was no resistance in my heart, and I couldn't resist at all. I fell to the ground, and I bowed my head in worship from a distance in the direction of the cave.
"This is?...Dragon God? Oh my god..."
The huge aura soaring into the sky rolled up countless white clouds in the sky, rolling and jumping continuously.
Especially spectacular.
On the mainland.
Among the four colleges, four old men suddenly opened their eyes and shouted in disbelief: "Supreme level??? Who is it???"
In an ordinary corner, two elderly people were planting trees and flowers. The scissors in their hands trembled. They looked up at each other and saw the solemnity in each other's eyes. As soon as their figures moved, the people disappeared. Only the leaves that were accidentally dropped on the side proved that someone had existed here.
Somewhere in mainland ChinaIn a huge city, there is a gorgeous church at the top. An old man in white robes is reading the Bible and wearing a holy crown on his head. Suddenly his body moves and the person is gone. Only a scripture that has just been translated is left.
In the twenty-third year of the continental calendar, the aura of the supreme power once again appeared in the human kingdom.
Outside the human kingdom, many strong men let out deep sighs.
"Humans are indeed a race of gods."
****************
In the cave, Liu Feng stared at the billowing white smoke in shock.
He also felt the aura just now, but it didn't seem to be hostile to him.
Therefore, the breath just slipped by his side gently, but even so, Liu Feng also felt the power of that breath.
The powerful aura carries four words: unparalleled.
After a while, the breath slowly stopped and the white smoke gradually disappeared.
Suddenly, a flash of golden light flashed through the void and rushed into Liu Feng's arms.
I was shocked again by this speed. I couldn't be this fast even if I used the Wind Step, right?
Looking down at the cute creature in his arms, Liu Feng was filled with joy.
Camel head, snake neck, deer antlers, turtle eyes, fish scales, tiger paws, eagle claws, and ox ears.
